title: The roadmap-one-writer refusal tells the session to fetch before it asks the owner to push
why: A local triage session twice asked the owner to push a commit he had already pushed: its copy of the roadmap branch was stale, and the guard refuses before git reaches GitHub, so the refusal could not say the commit was already there (owner's ask ask-mw79vy66rf, 21:28 CST Nov 7).
note: Fix: the refusal's remedy says to run `git fetch origin roadmap` and to ask the owner only when the commit is not on origin/roadmap. Remedy text only; the hook adds no network call. The debt local-triage-tier-proof removes the situation once local triage can push. Filed 21:30 CST Nov 7. Lane session_013NEJL4KjioFCNuafMd8V8Q started (coordinator, received 21:39 CST Nov 7). Nov 7 22:47 CST: #1777 handed to runner 8. Note from the lane: test RECORD_CARRIES pins neither "exit 0" nor "the commit the push would send". A note, not a debt.
